thread_title: S. purpurea ssp. purpurea Wellington Co, ON
breadcrumb: S. purpurea ssp. purpurea Wellington Co, ON

posts.body_html:
Here's a very unique clone of S. purpurea ssp. purpurea from Wellington Co, ON. It has a really nice neon-green color on the outer edge of the pitcher, and it produces this coloration consistently. My friend Drew Martinez grows this clone as well, and in his collection, the plant displays the same characteristics, which makes me think it's a genetic thing.

Anyhow, enjoy the photos:












And here you can see it with many other different clones in the collection. It definitely sticks out!
